before-we-continue.notes: The Readiness Check intro card (u10a; 5.1, 5.2). Mar'tu's line is the spec's. Names the struggle kindly once (teacher decision 2), then the plan in the order the items come: the twelve questions first (so the first win is a prediction), then the nine tasks, the mini-boss and the one click. It leads with what stays on, not with what is off, and points to rc-review (Mar'tu's Notes), which comes right after Part 1. Every student works alone on their own device. Time: 2 + 10 + 18 + 15 + 1 = 46 core minutes; rc-review (15) is optional and only for a miss.

The best score counts; a retake should draw another form's questions (site work). i4b is typed, with no choices (honest tracing). Unaided: no hints; glossary and read-aloud stay on. rc-part1-a.notes:
Readiness Check Part 1, form A (curriculum 5.2, 5.3): the 9 code items, in the spec's order (items 2, 3b, 5b, 6a-c, 7b, 8b, 11, 12, 13). The questions (items 1, 3a, 4a, 4b, 5a, 6d, 7a, 8a, 9a, 9b, 10a, 10b) live in rc-part1-a-questions, which comes first in the unit's list, so the first win is a prediction; this form follows it, and rc-review (Mar'tu's Notes) follows this form. Unaided: support='none' and explainer='lean' on every task; glossary and read-aloud stay on (G1 R25). Every typed task is behavior-checked (CMB, PAR, BND, CALL, RND, STO, KEY), never OUT alone (T5). Pass heuristic (5.5), as far as the schema can hold it: every code task (the testout's rule) plus questions_to_pass=10 of 12, which approximates 'Part 1 >= 11/13' (two question misses allowed). 'Item 6 at >= 3 of 4 parts' and 'item 13 passed' hold automatically, since items 6a-c and 13 are required tasks.
This is the required form: optional=False, the only testout in the course that is not optional. The site's Readiness flow lists it as a core item and never tests the unit out with it (site request: a required testout is a core item, with no unit test-out, so passing it, or a later form or rc-recheck, never marks the mini-boss or rc-explain as tested out). Forms B (u10b) and C (u10c) are the optional retakes.
What the site still lacks (site work): per-item scoring (13 items, mixed code and question parts), the Ready / Ready with a review list / Review first result, per-skill review routing as links (rc-review names them in prose; each task's notes list its review exercises), and form choice (a retake draws form B or C, and a quiz retake draws another form's questions). ~28 minutes in all (10 for the questions, 18 for the tasks).
